hooks.name: Terraform fmt after save
hooks.description: Runs terraform fmt -recursive when a .tf file is saved. The command uses sh and skips when terraform is not on PATH. On Windows, replace it with terraform fmt -recursive.

action.command: sh -c 'if command -v terraform >/dev/null 2>&1; then terraform fmt -recursive; else echo "terraform is not on PATH; fmt skipped"; fi'

hooks.name: Remind on long-lived keys and admin policies
hooks.description: When an IAM or SCP file changes, remind the agent to prefer roles and SCPs over long-lived access keys.

action.prompt: A file matching IAM, policy, SCP, or Organizations was just saved. Before you continue, check the diff for long-lived IAM access keys, AdministratorAccess, or Action * on Resource *. If you find one, stop and recommend a role, IAM Identity Center, or an SCP guardrail instead. Do not invent credentials or apply the change.
